title: John Hutchison's lab in Vancouver

tellings.quote: which I witnessed when I went over to his home. It was stuffed full of old oscilloscopes

plain: An experimenter named John Hutchison ran a home lab in Vancouver, Canada, from about 1990 to 2009, where he worked on strange effects linked to the idea of antigravity. Nick Cook, a writer who has looked into antigravity research, tells Michels he visited the home and saw that it "was stuffed full of old oscilloscopes," and he mentions an engineer named Boyd Bushman alongside Hutchison. If Hutchison's work was what it is said to be, a lone tinkerer would have touched on technology governments are said to keep secret.
